title: ^MICROBIAL INFLUENCES ON HUMAN HEALTH
description: Explores how microorganisms contribute in beneficial and detrimental ways to human health. Emphasizes microbial contributions to cancer, gut health, chronic infection and autoimmune diseases.
registration_restrictions:
Prerequisites: MB 302 or 302H.
A minimum grade of D- is required in MB 302 and MB 302H.

Enrollment limited to students with a term class standing of Junior or Senior.

Enrollment is limited to students with a program in Microbiology (570) or BioHealth Sciences (606).
